name: Respecting Your Parents
overview: Scripture commands believers to honor and respect their parents as a direct command from the LORD, promising long life and well-being in the land He gives (Exodus 20:12; Deuteronomy 5:16). This respect includes fearing and obeying one's mother and father, heeding their instruction, and maintaining reverence for their authority (Leviticus 19:3; Proverbs 1:8). The seriousness of this command is underscored by the severe consequences for cursing or rebelling against parents, emphasizing the sacredness of the parent-child relationship within God's design (Exodus 21:17; Deuteronomy 21:18).
